thought: Polio couldn't stop him. He threw a world-record javelin anyway.
support: Mahendra Gurjar, who lives with a polio-related leg impairment from childhood, competes in the F42 javelin classification. At the Nottwil World Para Athletics Grand Prix in Switzerland in May 2025, he threw 61.17m on his third attempt, breaking the previous world-record mark of 59.19m set by Brazil's Roberto Floriani Edenilson in 2022.
